original.target_description: Original Experiment 1a visual search; full original paper could not be acquired within the acquisition window.

replication.target_description: Experiment 1: effect of hand posture on search rate (posture × set-size interaction) across lap, post, pray, and screen; four-posture repeated-measures ANOVA.

n.location: p. 3, Experiment 1, Methods—Participants; p. 4, Results—Response times
n.quote: Sixty-two University of Notre Dame undergraduates participated in Experiment 1.
n.sample_role: participants in repeated-measures visual-search response-time analysis
n.exclusions: Incorrect-response trials and within-person/condition response times outside 2.5 * SD from the mean excluded; overall 7% of trials excluded. No participant exclusions reported; F(1, 61) confirms the 62-person analysis.

es.quote: 80, and 95 ms for lap, post, pray, and screen, respectively; F < 1,

reported_success.quote: Surprisingly, Experiment 1 failed to replicate the original finding of Abrams et al. (2008), with no significant difference in the set size effects between the lap and screen postures.

notes: Replication title verified from cached full PDF text. Reported success is the authors’ Experiment 1 verdict about the original lap-versus-screen modulation, not a significance-based verdict for the set-size main effect. Descriptions mentioning pray and post identify added replication postures; both assigned tests use the four-posture omnibus analysis, not a separately printed pray-versus-post contrast. No conventional p printed for the posture × set-size interaction; PBIC is not a p-value. Original acquisition: DOI landing page did not provide full text; primary-reference title verified in authoritative metadata; CiteSeer PDF returned 404 in terminal and was inaccessible via web; OpenAlex best_oa_location is null and its only locations are DOI and PubMed. No original statistics inferred from replication discussion.
